variables.name: source_station
variables.label: Departure Station (Origin)
variables.help_text: Select the origin station where your journey begins.

variables.name: destination_station
variables.label: Arrival Station (Destination)
variables.help_text: Select your destination station. Must be different from departure.

variables.name: travel_date
variables.label: Travel Date
variables.help_text: Select your planned travel date (within configured advance booking window).

variables.name: ticket_type
variables.label: Ticket Type
variables.help_text: Single Journey, Return Ticket (with return discount), or All-Day Pass.

variables.name: passenger_count
variables.label: Number of Passengers
variables.help_text: Headcount for group or single travel (up to 6 passengers per booking).

variables.name: estimated_distance
variables.label: Calculated Distance (km)
variables.help_text: Advisory track distance calculated from official route table.

variables.name: estimated_unit_fare
variables.label: Unit Fare ($)
variables.help_text: Calculated fare per individual passenger for the selected ticket type.

variables.name: estimated_total_fare
variables.label: Total Estimated Fare ($)
variables.help_text: Total fare for all passengers. Will be authoritatively verified on submission.
